general.about: Artist-designer-student working with interfaces, creative technology, and data.

projects.heading: Cafe23 Website
projects.description: I developed a Ruby-based web application for managing internal employee operations at a café. The system was built with a strong emphasis on the MVC (Model-View-Controller) structure and ensuring security measures to grant appropriate access levels for different user types.
projects.title: Cafe23 Website

projects.heading: STREET TYPER
projects.description: I produced a two-player competitive typing video game inspired by arcade, ASCII, and terminal. My role as producer involved leading the creative direction and overseeing project development of the game.
projects.title: STREET TYPER

projects.heading: Duquesne Incline Web Development
projects.description: I designed and developed a fully-responsive website for Pittsburgh's Duquesne Incline to learn HTML/CSS/Javascript. User stories, wireframes, and user testing was done to clarify site navigation.
projects.title: Duquesne Incline Web Development

sideProjects.heading: VEYANE
sideProjects.description: An explorative vessel to play with the pseudo-anonymity of internet identity. I'm nurturing my childhood memories, anime-inspired fantasies, and nostalgic ideals with amalgamation doodles, stream-of-consciousness illustrations, and formal drawing studies on Instagram.
sideProjects.title: VEYANE

sideProjects.heading: rabbit on a journey 🐇
sideProjects.description: A website journey + video homage to ASCII art and how the internet draws boundaries between reality and fantasy.
sideProjects.title: rabbit on a journey 🐇

writing.heading: Communcation Design Processes, Medium
writing.description: A few articles that offer a glimpse into my design process/thinking and provide a bit of documentation on the steps involved in bringing a design from concept to fruition. Staying transparent and practicing articulation :-)
writing.title: Communcation Design Processes

workExperience.heading: Co-Director of Public Relations at Lunar Gala
workExperience.description: I'm co-leading the digital marketing team for Pittsburgh’s largest annual fashion show with 1,000+ attendees.
workExperience.title: Co-Director of Public Relations

workExperience.heading: Creative Assistant at Iris Lunar Rover
workExperience.description: I'm designing media and creative assets for Iris marketing, merchandise, and outreach. Iris Rover will be the first academic rover to explore the moon in 2023 — paving the way for lightweight alternatives to space exploration. 🌙
workExperience.title: Creative Assistant

workExperience.heading: Corporate Marketing Intern at XiFin, Inc.
workExperience.description: I customized webinar/presentation decks and UI/UX graphics across content networks to optimize branding, and integrated digital asset management systems with internal platforms. This involved designing team-specific dashboards, transferring 200+ assets, and simplifying metadata taxonomy.
workExperience.title: Corporate Marketing Intern

education.heading: Bachelor of Humanities & Art (BHA) in Information Systems and Art at Carnegie Mellon University
education.description: Concentrating in UI/UX and Electronic/Time-Based Media. Minor in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI).
education.degree: Bachelor of Humanities & Art (BHA) in Information Systems and Art
